name: 10pines-c2-portfolio-treeprinter
title: Portfolio transfers, certificates of deposit and tree printer (Visitor)
description: On a finished account/portfolio composite the student adds transfers between accounts and certificates of deposit, a human-readable account summary ('Deposito por 100', 'Plazo fijo por 1000 durante 30 dias a una tna de 10%'), the net transferred, the net invested and the investment earnings, and depth-first and reverse printers of the portfolio tree, choosing the API by implementing six test-support methods; the course expects the Visitor pattern over the transactions and over the composite.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C2 - Diseño Avanzado de Software con Objetos II

design.notes: Five operations over a heterogeneous collection of four transaction kinds plus two traversals of the composite: the naive path is isKindOf: / class checks or polluting the transactions with printing and reporting methods, the intended one is double dispatch (accept:/visit...) with one visitor per operation, and a transfer that must appear as a transaction in two accounts at once.
